terms.meaning: Information that tells the compiler what shape a value has, so mistakes are caught early.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Generated type helpers
sections.what: Gives the compiler the type information for Next.js. It does not change what the user sees.
sections.why: Created by Next.js so the code checker understands the framework.
sections.watch_out: Edits are overwritten the next time the project builds.

summary: An automatically created file that gives TypeScript the type information Next.js needs.
purpose: Lets the editor and the compiler understand Next.js routes and settings.
why: Created by Next.js; the file itself says not to edit it.
how: 1) Points to Next.js type files. 2) Points to generated route and parameter type files.
inputs: Generated files in the build output folder.
outputs: Type information only. It does not change how the app runs.
risks: Manual edits are overwritten the next time the project is built.
debug: If type errors mention routes, delete the generated build folder and rebuild so the files regenerate.
